# DeckLink SDK interface files

This directory contains Linux DeckLink SDK headers and dispatch code, including
API headers copyright 2016 Blackmagic Design. The host supplies Desktop Video,
including `libDeckLinkAPI.so` and its kernel driver.

Each file retains its original Blackmagic Design copyright and license grant.
The grant permits source redistribution with the complete notice retained.
Only the headers needed by `DeckLinkAPI.h` and its dispatch source are included.
